name: SeatGeek
description: SeatGeek event discovery: search events by team, artist, venue, place, date and category; event, performer and venue detail; search-box suggestions; event-level ticket availability snapshots (listing and ticket counts, price range). Reads the anonymous SeatGeek Platform API (api.seatgeek.com/2) with the web app's public client id. Per-listing offers are behind DataDome and not covered.

tools.name: Event
tools.description: Detail for an event id from search_events, suggest or a pasted seatgeek.com event URL.

options.name: event_id
options.about: Numeric SeatGeek event id. Exactly one of event_id or url.

options.name: url
options.about: A seatgeek.com event URL (https://seatgeek.com/{slug}-tickets/{type}/{date}/{id}); the trailing number is the event id.

response.about: One SeatGeek event by id or public URL (api.seatgeek.com /2/events/{id}): the search_events record plus description, provider ids at other ticketing sites, seating map configuration and sales end. Availability is the API's event-level stats snapshot (listing and ticket counts, price range across listings); per-listing offers with section, row and quantity live behind DataDome (/2/event_listings_v2) and are not available. Unknown ids fail with not_found.

fields.name: all_in_price_on_event_page
fields.about: Whether the site shows all-in (fee-inclusive) prices on this event's page.

fields.name: availability
fields.about: Event-level availability snapshot from the API's stats object: counts and price range across all marketplace listings (primary and resale are not distinguished at this level). A snapshot, not a reservation. Null when the API sends no stats. Per-listing offers (section, row, quantity) are behind DataDome and not available from this program.

fields.name: date_tbd
fields.about: Date not yet announced.

fields.name: datetime_local
fields.about: Local start time at the venue, ISO 8601 without offset (see timezone). May be a placeholder when time_tbd/date_tbd is true.

fields.name: datetime_tbd
fields.about: Date and time not yet announced.

fields.name: datetime_utc
fields.about: Start time in UTC, ISO 8601 without the Z suffix as the API sends it.

fields.name: external_ids
fields.about: Ids of the same event at other ticketing providers (event.links[] with link_type ID plus event.ticketmaster).

fields.name: id
fields.about: SeatGeek event id; stable identifier, last path segment of the public event URL.

fields.name: is_open
fields.about: Whether the API marks the event as open.

fields.name: observed_at_ms
fields.about: Unix epoch milliseconds when this snapshot was taken by the program.

fields.name: schedule_status
fields.about: Scheduling status as the API states it; observed: as_originally_scheduled, rescheduled.

fields.name: seating_map
fields.about: Seating map configuration from event.venue_config; null when absent.

fields.name: source_url
fields.about: The API request the record came from (api.seatgeek.com).

fields.name: status
fields.about: Event status as the API states it; observed: normal. Cancelled or postponed values were not observed during reconnaissance.

fields.name: time_tbd
fields.about: Time not yet announced.

fields.name: timezone
fields.about: IANA timezone of datetime_local, from the venue.

fields.name: type
fields.about: Event type as the API states it (mlb, concert, entertainment, ...).

fields.name: url
fields.about: Public event page on seatgeek.com (source URL).

fields.name: venue
fields.about: The venue the event is at; null when the API has none (TBA events).

fields.name: visible_until_utc
fields.about: When the event stops being listed, UTC.

tools.name: Search events
tools.description: Discovery: find events for a team, artist, venue, place or date range, then pass an event id to event.

options.name: end_date
options.about: Latest local event date, YYYY-MM-DD inclusive (datetime_local.lte). Pattern: ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$.

options.name: event_ids
options.about: Explicit event ids to look up in bulk (1-50).

options.name: latitude
options.about: Centre of a radius search; requires longitude.

options.name: longitude
options.about: longitude

options.name: page
options.about: 1-based page; use next_page from the previous call.

options.name: per_page
options.about: Results per page; the API caps at 100.

options.name: performer_id
options.about: Numeric SeatGeek performer id.

options.name: performer_slug
options.about: Performer URL slug, e.g. new-york-yankees (from performer or search_performers). Pattern: ^[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*$.

options.name: query
options.about: Free-text search (team, artist, show, venue).

options.name: range_miles
options.about: Radius in miles around latitude/longitude (default 30 when a centre is given).

options.name: sort
options.about: Result order. Default is the API's relevance order.

options.name: start_date
options.about: Earliest local event date, YYYY-MM-DD (datetime_local.gte). Pattern: ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$.

options.name: taxonomy
options.about: Taxonomy name as the API uses it, e.g. concert, mlb, theater, comedy (taxonomies.name). Pattern: ^[a-z0-9_]+$.

options.name: venue_id
options.about: Numeric SeatGeek venue id.

response.about: Search SeatGeek events (api.seatgeek.com /2/events) by free text, performer slug or id, venue id, explicit event ids, a lat/lon radius, a local date window and/or a taxonomy name, sorted and paged (per_page up to 100). At least one filter is required. Each event carries its stable id, public URL, local and UTC start, venue with timezone, performers, taxonomies, status/schedule_status and an event-level availability snapshot (listing and ticket counts, price range). Coverage is the SeatGeek marketplace (US and Canada); prices carry no currency in the API (the US site displays USD) and fee inclusion is unknown.

tools.name: Search venues
tools.description: Find a venue id by name or list venues in a city before listing events at a venue.

options.name: city
options.about: City name, e.g. chicago.

options.name: page
options.about: 1-based page; use next_page from the previous call.

options.name: per_page
options.about: Results per page; the API caps at 100.

options.name: query
options.about: Free-text venue name.

options.name: state
options.about: Two-letter state/province code, e.g. IL; only meaningful with city. Pattern: ^[A-Za-z]{2}$.

response.about: Search SeatGeek venues (api.seatgeek.com /2/venues) by free text and/or city and state, paged. Returns venue ids for search_events.venue_id and venue, with address, timezone, capacity and upcoming event counts.

fields.name: url
fields.about: Public venue page on seatgeek.com.

response.about: SeatGeek search-box suggestions (api.seatgeek.com /2/autosuggest) for a partial query: mixed top results plus separate event, performer and venue lists with ids for event, performer and venue. Rate limited upstream to 25 requests per 10 seconds.
